_comment: spa_routes = SPA-owned page routes, matched EXACTLY (not by prefix). Plan 3 Task 9 flipped this from the temporary ['/app'] scaffold to ['/'] (the React dashboard now owns the root; the Jinja calls_index was retired). The root special-case in is_spa_route owns ONLY '/' — '/calls/1', '/api/x', '/made-up-page' all fall through to FastAPI's real 404. backend_prefixes drives the Task-5 dev-proxy carve-out only; these are the real top-level prefixes mounted in main.py (golden-set lives under /admin; rubric/sections/annotations/files/references/citations all live under /workspaces; there is no /events route yet).
